D=/tmp/morph/a-p2; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)-$$; L=$D/acc-$S.log
cp src/x/a.ts $D/0-$S.ts 2>/dev/null
cp tests/x/a.test.ts $D/1-$S.ts 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 export NO_COLOR=1 CI=1
P=$PWD/probe/a; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; trap 'rm -rf $P' EXIT
cat > $P/guard.mjs <<'MORPH_GUARD_EOF'
// guard
MORPH_GUARD_EOF
cat > $P/probe.config.mts <<'MORPH_CONF_EOF'
import { defineConfig } from "vitest/config";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
export default defineConfig({
  root: fileURLToPath(new URL("../..", import.meta.url)),
  test: { environment: "node", include: ["probe/a/**/*.probe.ts"],
    setupFiles: ["tests/setup.ts"], chaiConfig: { truncateThreshold: 200 } },
});
MORPH_CONF_EOF
cat > $P/tsconfig.card.json <<'MORPH_TSCONF_EOF'
{
  "extends": "../../tsconfig.json",
  "include": [
    "../../src",
    "../../tests",
    "./*.probe.ts"
  ]
}
MORPH_TSCONF_EOF
cat > $P/firstdiff.mjs <<'MORPH_FIRSTDIFF_EOF'
// firstdiff
MORPH_FIRSTDIFF_EOF
cat > $P/a.probe.ts <<'MORPH_PROBE_EOF'
// probe
MORPH_PROBE_EOF
G0=$( (git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || true; git rev-parse HEAD; git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)') 2>&1)
echo '== tsc'; node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p $P/tsconfig.card.json
echo '== eslint'; E=0; node_modules/.bin/eslint src/x/a.ts tests/x/a.test.ts || E=1
echo '== guard'; node $P/guard.mjs src src/x/a.ts; node $P/guard.mjs tests tests/x/a.test.ts 1 5
echo '== probe'; node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config $P/probe.config.mts --reporter=dot > $P/vt.log 2>&1 || { if grep -q '^ FAIL ' $P/vt.log; then awk '/^ FAIL /{p=1} p' $P/vt.log | grep -vE '^ +(Start at|Duration) ' | head -200; else tail -60 $P/vt.log; fi; node $P/firstdiff.mjs $P/vt.log; exit 1; }
echo '== own'; node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/x/a.test.ts --reporter=dot > $P/vt.log 2>&1 || { if grep -q '^ FAIL ' $P/vt.log; then awk '/^ FAIL /{p=1} p' $P/vt.log | grep -vE '^ +(Start at|Duration) ' | head -200; else tail -60 $P/vt.log; fi; node $P/firstdiff.mjs $P/vt.log; exit 1; }
[ "$E" = 0 ] || { echo "== eslint failed (see above); every step between it and here passed"; exit 1; }
echo '== bin'; true
echo '== full'; node_modules/.bin/vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude tests/x/old.test.ts --reporter=dot > $P/vt.log 2>&1 || { if grep -q '^ FAIL ' $P/vt.log; then awk '/^ FAIL /{p=1} p' $P/vt.log | grep -vE '^ +(Start at|Duration) ' | head -200; else tail -60 $P/vt.log; fi; node $P/firstdiff.mjs $P/vt.log; exit 1; }
echo '== own git'; G1=$( (git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || true; git rev-parse HEAD; git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)') 2>&1); [ "$G0" = "$G1" ] || { echo "tests changed this repository's HEAD or refs:"; echo "before: $G0" | head -5; echo "after: $G1" | head -5; exit 1; }
echo '== frozen'; git diff --quiet HEAD -- contour.yaml morph-map.json docs decks tests/fixtures || { echo "changed outside the targets: $(git diff --name-only HEAD -- contour.yaml morph-map.json docs decks tests/fixtures | tr "\n" " ")"; exit 1; }
X=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vxF -e src/x/a.ts -e tests/x/a.test.ts || true); [ -z "$X" ] || { echo "files left in the tree: $X"; exit 1; }
) > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $L; exit $rc
